name: Violet Rafale
original_name: ヴィオレ・ラファール
source:
Affiliation: Elusion
Post: Mechanic
Birthplace: Yemen (Sana'a)

A ladies man who calls out to any woman he sees.
He brags that his type is "any woman", but it seems he doesn't go for girls under 20.
